Decision.AttributionNote: 古雪哲禪師語錄, hall address for completion of a life-release pond. Guxue Zhenzhe is the exact speaker: after quoting the Brahma Net precept on rescue, he pairs Nanquan cutting the cat with Guizong cutting the snake and asks what expedient could have saved them.

decisions.Kwic: 具殺活機，方能權衡佛祖

Decision.AttributionNote: 古雪哲禪師語錄, hall address at Guifeng Monastery. Guxue Zhenzhe is the exact speaker: he says only one with real conduct can benefit humans and celestials, and only one equipped with the mechanism of killing and giving life can weigh buddhas and patriarchs.

decisions.Kwic: 遇上根利智教伊參禪，中、下二機即令念佛，對機說法。何是？何非？

Decision.AttributionNote: 古雪哲禪師語錄, hall instruction on Chan and Pure Land methods. Guxue Zhenzhe is the exact speaker: he describes assigning Chan inquiry to sharp higher-capacity students and buddha-recitation to middle and lower capacities as teaching in response to the encounter.
